next_step: POC ingest + 2-week eval; SE to run reranker tuning workshop
notes:
Overview:
- Constellation operates a 45PB archive of broadcast/video transcripts, long-form articles, and legacy newsroom documents. Heavy read/query traffic from editorial teams and B2B licensing partners.
- Primary goal: fast, relevant search over very long docs (avg 10k-60k tokens). Move from keyword search -> RAG + rerank.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Indexing scale: ~400M chunks expected after dedupe for initial 3-year window. Plan for incremental ingestion at 20M chunks/month.
- Chunking strategy under evaluation: 2-stage approach preferred: 1) semantic chunking at 1.2k-1.6k token windows for embeddings (content-aware boundaries), 2) sliding overlap for edge cases (300 token overlap). Also testing hierarchical chapter-level vectors for coarse retrieval.
- Vector index: HNSW + sharding across 8 nodes for HA; prefer FAISS-compatible export. Need incremental upserts, delta deletes.
- Reranker: cross-encoder ensemble (distil-cross-encoder for latency-sensitive routes, larger cross-encoder on critical licensing queries). Two-stage rerank to limit cost: top-200 embed candidates -> fast cross-encoder re-score (top-10) -> final heavyweight model for licensing QA only.
- Latency targets: p95 end-to-end < 400ms for editorial search (interactive), < 750ms for heavy licensing queries (with heavyweight reranker). First-pass ANN target p95 < 80ms.
- Throughput: baseline 150 qps for internal users; burst to 600 qps for licensing bursts.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query < $0.01 across average mix (embeddings + light rerank); vendor cap for POC: $0.02/query.
- Security: VPC-only control plane, customer KMS for keys, audit logging for every query and index mutation, 7-year retention controls for given doc classes.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: sample ingest (1.2M tokens -> ~15k chunks) using Redwood private deployment image in Constellation VPC. Baseline embedding store with HNSW.
- Week 1: run retrieval latency/cost baseline. Validate chunking heuristics (semantic vs fixed-window) on 4 canonical queries.
- Week 2: SE-led reranker tuning workshop: test batch vs online reranking, tune relevance thresholds and loss weighting on curated eval set (2k labelled pairs).
- Week 3: scale test to 50M chunks in sandbox, measure p95 under 200 qps.
- Week 4: security review and KMS integration; hand off to procurement if metrics OK.

Timeline / recent activities:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (FF: ff_2026-01-12_99753) with CTO + Head of Search. Covered business drivers and initial dataset sizes.
- 2026-01-25: Architecture workshop with Infra + Security. Constellation requested VPC-only control plane and HSM/KMS details.
- 2026-02-02: Demo of Redwood Dedicated + streaming rerank concept. AE walked through two-stage pipeline.
- 2026-02-18: POC kickoff call (FF: ff_2026-02-18_11022). SE scope agreed; Redwood to provide ingestion scripts and quantization recommendations.

Quotes / Call notes (shorthand):
- "We need editorial-grade precision — false positives cost licensing deals." — Head of Search
- "If the reranker adds 200ms but halves false positives, we can justify it for licensing flows." — VP Product
- Security: "We cannot have keys outside our KMS. Audit trail must be query-level and immutable."

Decision criteria / success metrics:
- Relevance: +15% NDCG over current Elastic baseline on 10k eval queries.
- Latency: first-pass ANN p95 < 80ms; overall p95 < 400ms for interactive flows.
- Cost: average end-to-end cost per search < $0.01 (embeddings + light rerank).
- Ops: ability to do rolling upserts and shard rebalancing with <1% query error rate during maintenance windows.

Open questions / blockers (as of last update):
- Security sign-off path for HSM; expected 4-week review by Constellation InfoSec.
- Exact sizing for Dedicated GPU pool (seeking Redwood recommendation: 4x A100-80GB equiv?).
- Index SLA: Constellation wants 99.95% read availability for search; need Redwood infra SLA carveout.
